comment: Season 1 reference entries, created from the locked factory arena.sledgit.near (each owner calls create_vault). Copy to deploy/mainnet/season1.json (git-ignored) and replace every <...>. One owner and one agent account per entry, each funded on its own; no account may appear in two entries, and none may be the factory or its parent. Owners/agents can be named (.near) or implicit (64 hex). recovery_public_key (optional, per entry): the public key of a full-access key John holds offline (e.g. a Ledger key); if omitted, the tool generates one into ~/.config/sledgit/RECOVERY-mainnet-agent-<name>.json for John to move offline. To change the entries: edit 'entries' (names 2-32 of a-z, 0-9, inner '-'). Amounts are human units. No secrets here.

stake.comment: Used only by entries with "stake": true. stNEAR (Meta Pool) on Rhea rated pool 3514. Bands 3% under the 2026-11-17 redemption rate (1.5156 NEAR per stNEAR); the rate rises about 4.5% a year, so min_price_stake needs re-proposing about every 8 months.
